title: Bunny's blues feel as Norvo first heard it
summary: The roadhouse performance affected him deeply; Bunny had warmth and blues feel, and sang.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the blues is, and why every jazz player needs it

blocks.x: But Bunny, when I heard him in that road-

house, it affected me, it just was warm and harmony seemed to have that wonderful feel. When the guys would -- that would probably be a layman's way of saying, playing jazz -- he plays the blues, like he plays wonderful sounding things that --
But he did have a real feel for blues, too.
He had that wonderful sound and feel for blues.
